summary.answer:
**8 of the 14 countries missed their 2023 target.** One of them is Mexico, which had no 2023 revenue at all (see note 1).

| Country | Target | Actual 2023 | Shortfall | % below target |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| United States | 210,000 | 194,733 | **−15,267** | −7.3% |
| Mexico | 15,000 | 0 (no data) | **−15,000** | −100% |
| South Korea | 60,000 | 51,443 | −8,557 | −14.3% |
| France | 45,000 | 39,412 | −5,588 | −12.4% |
| Spain | 40,000 | 34,440 | −5,560 | −13.9% |
| Australia | 25,000 | 21,225 | −3,775 | −15.1% |
| Poland | 5,000 | 2,480 | −2,520 | −50.4% |
| Colombia | 1,000 | 50 | −950 | −95.0% |

Altogether, the misses add up to about **$57.2K**.

**Beat their target (6):** China +20,437 (+7.3%), Brasil +12,263 (+10.2%), United Kingdom +2,766, Germany +2,169, Japan +1,990 and Belgium +804.

**Two things to check:**
1. **Mexico:** I didn't find any 2023 revenue for Mexico in thelook_ecommerce, so the table counts it as $0. It may be that the dataset simply has no Mexican users, so its target can't really be judged.
2. **Spain / España:** Some Spanish customers are recorded in the data as "España" instead of "Spain", worth $148.93. If you count them as Spain, Spain's actual is $34,589 and it misses by $5,411 instead of $5,560.

Your file uses "Brasil", and that matched the dataset as is. All amounts are in USD and come from order items created in 2023, leaving out Cancelled and Returned items.

Which countries missed their target, and by how much?

input.sql: SELECT u.country, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS revenue FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON oi.user_id=u.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at)=2023 AND oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned') GROUP BY 1

tools.name: duckdb_query

input.sql: SELECT coalesce(t.country,r.country) country, t.target_revenue_2023 target, round(r.revenue,2) actual, round(r.revenue - t.target_revenue_2023,2) diff, round(100*(r.revenue/t.target_revenue_2023-1),1) pct FROM att_a1 t FULL JOIN bq_rev r ON t.country=r.country ORDER BY diff
